versions.content: If the configuration item KeyMCryptoKeyVerifyFunctionEnabled is set to TRUE, the crypto key submodule shall provide the function KeyM_Verify(). This function can be triggered by the key master and is used to run a crypto job referenced by KeyMCryptoKeyCsmVerifyJobRef. KeyM_Verify() can be called at any time and is not bound to an active crypto key session.
